leaves.name: fowlerProp27PrintCanonical
leaves.doc: Fowler, Proposition 2·7: for an imaginary quadratic order discriminant Δ < 0 congruent to 0 or 1 modulo 4 and positive n, h(Δ) ≤ n implies √|Δ| ≤ 2n² exp(21000n²), with h(Δ) the proper ideal class number of the unique order of discriminant Δ.
leaves.flag: Human reading of the publisher PDF recorded in docs/research/fowler-bridges.md; Lean proves that the order and its proper class number are determined by Δ.
leaves.source: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on André–Oort for sums of powers in ℂⁿ, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026), Proposition 2·7, p. 615; definition p. 613; manuscript L588–593.
